question: Which 2025 novel by Colum McCann follows a journalist on a submarine cable-laying ship?

options.text: Under the Eye of the Big Bird

solution:
The correct answer is __**Twist**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Twist**, written by **Colum McCann**, is a novel set to be published in **2025**. It focuses on the intricate and often overlooked process of laying submarine cables.
 
• The book follows a **journalist** who embarks on a journey aboard a **submarine cable-laying ship**, delving into the technical, emotional, and philosophical aspects of intercontinental communication.
 
• The title "**Twist**" metaphorically represents the entanglement of human stories, technology, and the vast expanse of the ocean.
 
• Colum McCann is known for his **immersive storytelling** and has previously written acclaimed novels such as **Let the Great World Spin** and **Apeirogon**, which explore themes of interconnectedness and humanity.
 
• This novel is expected to provide a unique perspective on the **hidden infrastructure** that powers global communication, offering both a technical and emotional narrative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Submarine Cable-Laying Ships:**

 
 
• These specialized ships are used for deploying **undersea cables** that transmit data across continents.
 
• Submarine cables are the backbone of **global internet infrastructure**, handling about **99% of international communications**.
 
• The process involves meticulous planning, advanced technology, and a deep understanding of oceanic conditions.
 
 
 
• **Colum McCann's Writing Style:**
 
 
• McCann is celebrated for his ability to weave **multiple narratives** into a cohesive and emotionally resonant story.
 
• He often draws from **real-life events** and historical contexts, blending them with fictional elements to create a rich tapestry of human experiences.
 
 
 
• **Historical Significance of Submarine Cables:**
 
 
• The first successful submarine cable, the **Transatlantic Cable**, was laid in **1858**, marking a revolutionary moment in global communication.
 
• Modern cables are designed to withstand **oceanic pressures** and harsh environmental conditions, ensuring uninterrupted data flow.
 
 
 
• **Thematic Elements in "Twist":**
 
 
• The novel explores themes of **connection**, both technological and human, highlighting the invisible threads that bind societies together.
 
• It also delves into the environmental and ethical implications of technological advancement, making it a thought-provoking read.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Options Explained:**

 
 
• **Under the Eye of the Big Bird:** This title does not correspond to any known work by Colum McCann or align with the narrative of a submarine cable-laying ship.
 
• **Wild Dark Shore:** While evocative, this title does not relate to the technological or journalistic themes central to the question.
 
• **Silver Elite:** This title suggests a different context, potentially military or aristocratic, which is unrelated to the subject matter of the novel.
 
 
 
• **Relevance of Submarine Cables Today:**
 
 
• Submarine cables are critical for the functioning of the **global internet** and support services like **cloud computing**, **streaming**, and **financial transactions**.
 
• Issues like **cable damage** from natural disasters or human activities can disrupt global connectivity, highlighting their strategic importance.
